---
description: Review an inventory behavior change using implementation and test evidence
agent: agent
---

Review the attached inventory implementation and tests.

Check only:

- behavior against the stated acceptance criteria;
- uncovered boundary or state-transition cases;
- accidental public API changes;
- consistency with `.github/copilot-instructions.md`; and
- whether the reported test evidence supports the conclusion.

Lead with concrete findings ordered by severity. Reference the relevant file and
symbol. Do not edit files until asked. If there are no findings, say so and name
any remaining test gap or uncertainty.
